title: Deposit Defense Scenario Desk
oneLiner: A renter risk console that helps households stress-test deposit loss, contract timing, cash buffers, and fallback housing moves before one bad landlord situation wrecks family savings.
targetUser: Korean renters with meaningful jeonse or monthly-rent deposits who feel exposed to landlord risk, delayed returns, or relocation shocks.
keyUX: Compare best-case versus worst-case deposit recovery paths and leave with a concrete protection sequence before contract anxiety turns into paralysis.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop renter risk console called Deposit Defense Scenario Desk for households worried about deposit loss, contract timing, and relocation shocks. It should help users stress-test best-case and worst-case recovery paths, compare cash buffer resilience, and choose a protection sequence before landlord anxiety turns into paralysis. Include a deposit exposure summary, a contract deadline tracker, a landlord risk signal panel, a cash buffer stress-test matrix, a fallback housing option board, and a protection step memo drawer. Design direction: use a financial-analyst aesthetic with disciplined grid structure, muted navy framing, precise comparison tables, and controlled caution accents so the product feels rational, protective, and serious about preserving savings.
